subject: general
question: India is set to host the 2nd India-Arab Foreign Ministers' Meeting in __________, co-chaired with the __________, marking the first such gathering in 10 years.

options.text: New Delhi and the United Arab Emirates

solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi and the United Arab Emirates.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **India will host the 2nd India-Arab Foreign Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi on 31st Jan 2026, co-chaired with the United Arab Emirates, after a gap of ten years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The 2nd India-Arab Foreign Ministers' Meeting will be held in New Delhi and co-chaired by India and the UAE.**
 
• The meeting is taking place after a 10-year hiatus, with the first meeting held in 2016 in Bahrain.
 
• Foreign Ministers and senior officials from all 22 Arab League member states will participate.
 
• The meeting will focus on strengthening cooperation across five priority verticals: economy, energy, education, media, and culture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• India-Arab Foreign Ministers' Meeting__

 __
 
• Highest institutional mechanism guiding India-Arab partnership
 
• Dialogue process formalised in March 2002 through an MoU
 
• Aims to deepen strategic, economic and cultural cooperation
 
 
 
• League of Arab States__
 __
 
• Pan-Arab organization with 22 member countries
 
• India holds Observer status in the League
 
• Focuses on political, economic and cultural coordination among Arab nations
 
 
 
• India–UAE Relations__
 
 
• UAE is a key strategic partner of India in the Arab world
 
• Cooperation spans trade, energy, education and people-to-people ties
 
• UAE co-chairs the 2nd India-Arab Foreign Ministers' Meeting
